_comment: Payload fields Mordred plugins consume per Hermes hook. Keys must match exactly the hooks registered by mordred_hermes plugins (tests/test_hook_payload_drift.py enforces this); values are the sorted kwargs the handlers read. Consumers: network/hooks.py on_session_start (session_id), privacy_check + network pre_tool_call (tool_name), llm_guard + network pre_api_request (base_url, provider), extension/gateway_plugin.py pre_gateway_dispatch (event, gateway), activity/hooks_history.py pre_llm_call (user_message, session_id: the turn-start history context; task_id is read only when present, since the hermes-agent 0.13.0 floor does not pass it; dbcrypt's per-turn database check reads nothing), activity/capture_hermes.py pre_llm_call (user_message, session_id, platform: the turn's message and whether it is a person's words; task_id and turn_id only when present, absent in 0.13.0) and post_tool_call (tool_name, args, result, session_id, task_id, tool_call_id: Hermes's own browser calls; turn_id and status only when present, absent in 0.13.0) and activity/hooks_history.py transform_tool_result (tool_name, args, result, session_id, task_id: the browser navigation history block). on_session_end only needs the hook to fire.
